ci.evidence: Build precedes Citation lint; citation step and build-test job have no continue-on-error. Matrix fail-fast:false retains sibling runtime jobs. This is static workflow evidence, not a hosted CI run.

release.evidence: Default runStep requires exit status0 with no spawn error or timeout. DAG skips citations after a failed/missing required build; otherwise its failed result is retained.
